notes.offline: Diigo is primarily a cloud-based bookmarking and annotation service with no offline support. All bookmarks, annotations, and highlights are stored on Diigo servers.
notes.e2ee: No end-to-end encryption mentioned in documentation. Data is transmitted over HTTPS but stored unencrypted on servers, making it accessible to the service.
notes.bug-bounty: No public bug bounty program found. Security issues can be reported through [standard contact](https://www.diigo.com/contact) but no structured security researcher program.
notes.data-selling: According to their [privacy policy](https://www.diigo.com/privacy), Diigo does not sell personal information to third parties. However, they collect substantial usage data for service improvement.
notes.email-consent: Requires email registration. Users receive product updates and feature announcements. Privacy policy allows promotional emails but users can opt out.
notes.spam-rate: Users report moderate promotional email frequency. Some users find notification frequency high for group activities and social features.
notes.anonymous-data-collection: Collects extensive usage analytics including browsing patterns, bookmark data, and user interactions. Most bookmarks are private by default but can be made public.
notes.misuse: Long-established service (2005) with generally good reputation for data handling. No explicit zero-tolerance policy for data misuse but standard terms of service apply.

notes.bug-free: Generally good uptime with 19+ years of operation since 2005. No public status page but service has demonstrated long-term stability.
notes.uptime: Strong data integrity with bookmarks and annotations reliably preserved. Extensive backup systems maintain data across their 19-year history.
notes.performance: Good performance for bookmark loading but can be slow with very large collections (10,000+ bookmarks). Search performance is generally acceptable.
notes.sync-reliability: Generally reliable synchronization across devices. Some users report occasional sync delays with large bookmark collections.
notes.crash-free: Moderate bug frequency due to legacy codebase. Issues are typically resolved in regular updates but may take longer than newer services.
notes.platform-stability: Stable across web browsers and mobile apps. Browser extensions are well-maintained for Chrome and Firefox.

notes.setup-ease: Easy setup process with straightforward browser extension installation. Account creation requires only email and password.
notes.learning-curve: Moderate learning curve due to feature richness. Basic bookmarking is intuitive, but advanced features like Outliner require some learning.
notes.maintenance: Regular but less frequent updates compared to newer competitors. Development pace has slowed but core functionality remains well-maintained.

notes.email-support: Responsive [customer support](https://www.diigo.com/contact) with email-based assistance. Premium users receive priority support.
notes.community-support: Good [community support](https://www.diigo.com/community) through forums and discussions.
notes.documentation: Good [help documentation](https://help.diigo.com/) covering most features. Community forum provides additional user support.

notes.business-model: Freemium model with basic free service and [premium subscriptions](https://www.diigo.com/premium) providing additional features and storage.
notes.export-capabilities: Excellent export capabilities including CSV, HTML, and through [API access](https://www.diigo.com/api_dev). Strong data portability options.
notes.self-hosting: No self-hosting option available. Users are dependent on Diigo's cloud infrastructure for service continuity.
notes.data-portability: Strong data portability through multiple export formats and comprehensive API. Easy migration to other services.
notes.financial-stability: 19-year operational history with 9+ million users demonstrates financial sustainability. Established user base provides revenue stability.
notes.vendor-lock-in: Low vendor lock-in due to excellent export capabilities and open API access. Easy to migrate data to alternative services.

notes.offline-access: Very limited offline functionality. No native offline mode for bookmarks or annotations.
notes.cache-storage: Premium feature includes [web page archiving](https://www.diigo.com/premium) that stores full page snapshots, accessible when original sources are unavailable.
notes.sync-offline: No offline synchronization capabilities. All features require internet connection for access and updating.
notes.mobile-offline: Mobile apps have minimal offline capabilities, primarily for viewing previously loaded content.

notes.editor-support: Basic text formatting in notes and annotations. No dedicated markdown editor or advanced formatting options.
notes.syntax-support: Limited support for basic formatting like bold and italic. No support for headers, lists, code blocks, or advanced markdown syntax.
notes.rendering: Notes display with basic formatting applied but limited compared to full markdown rendering.
notes.import-export: Export formats maintain basic formatting but limited markdown compatibility for advanced syntax.

notes.annotation-quality: Good PDF annotation capabilities with highlighting and note-taking. Annotations are preserved and searchable.
notes.local-pdf-support: Supports both web-based PDFs and uploaded PDF files. Premium users can upload PDFs directly to Diigo.
notes.annotation-types: Supports text highlighting, sticky notes, and annotations. Good integration with overall bookmark organization.
notes.sync-across-devices: PDF annotations sync across devices and platforms. Can access annotated PDFs from any device.
notes.export-integration: PDF annotations included in export functionality and accessible through API.
notes.organization-integration: PDFs integrate well with Diigo's tagging and organizational features.

notes.standalone-notes: Can create standalone notes and comments. Sticky notes feature allows adding text annotations to any web page.
notes.note-quality: Basic note editor with simple formatting options. Notes can be substantial and detailed.
notes.organization: Notes integrate with bookmark organization system. Can be tagged and categorized like bookmarks.
notes.search-in-notes: Notes are fully searchable along with bookmarks and highlights. Good search integration across all content types.

notes.bookmarking-quality: Excellent bookmarking capabilities with browser extension. Easy one-click saving of web pages with full metadata capture.
notes.highlighting-features: Good text highlighting on web pages with highlights persisting when returning to pages. Multiple highlight colors available.
notes.sticky-notes: Unique sticky notes feature allows adding notes to any web page that persist across visits. Notes are attached to specific page locations.
notes.page-archiving: Premium feature includes full page archiving, creating permanent snapshots accessible even when original pages are removed.
notes.context-preservation: Maintains complete context including page title, URL, description, and user-added metadata.
notes.cross-browser-sync: Bookmarks and highlights sync across browsers and devices through cloud synchronization.

notes.video-bookmarking: Can bookmark video pages from YouTube, Vimeo, and other platforms. Captures video metadata and thumbnails.
notes.timestamp-support: Limited timestamp support. Can add notes about specific time points but no automatic timestamp linking.
notes.platform-coverage: Works with major video platforms but functionality is limited to basic bookmarking and note-taking.
notes.workflow-integration: Video bookmarks integrate with overall organization system but lack video-specific features.

notes.platform-support: Basic support for bookmarking content from social media platforms. Can save posts from Twitter, LinkedIn, and others.
notes.context-preservation: Maintains basic context from social posts but limited compared to dedicated social media archiving tools.
notes.group-sharing: Strong [group features](https://www.diigo.com/groups) allow collaborative bookmarking and social sharing of research.
notes.community-features: Public groups enable discovery of bookmarks shared by other users with similar interests.

notes.tagging-system: Excellent tagging system with support for multiple tags per bookmark. Tags are hierarchical and searchable.
notes.workflow-integration: Tagging integrated into bookmarking workflow with suggested tags and auto-completion.
notes.outliner-integration: Unique [Outliner feature](https://www.diigo.com/outliner) allows structured organization of bookmarks into hierarchical outlines.
notes.bulk-operations: Can apply tags and organization to multiple bookmarks simultaneously. Good batch editing capabilities.

notes.organizational-depth: Multi-level organization with tags, lists, and groups. [Outliner feature](https://www.diigo.com/outliner) provides unique hierarchical organization.
notes.collaborative-groups: Extensive [group functionality](https://www.diigo.com/groups) supports collaborative research and knowledge sharing.
notes.public-discovery: Public groups and bookmarks enable discovery of curated content from other users and organizations.
notes.management-tools: Comprehensive management tools for organizing large bookmark collections. Good bulk editing and reorganization features.
notes.search-integration: Collections integrate seamlessly with search functionality for quick retrieval.

notes.search-scope: Comprehensive search across bookmarks, highlights, notes, and tags. Includes full-text search of archived pages.
notes.search-quality: Good search relevance and speed even with large bookmark collections (10,000+ items).
notes.filtering-options: Advanced filtering by tags, date ranges, groups, and content types. Multiple search criteria can be combined.
notes.api-access: Search functionality available through [API](https://www.diigo.com/api_dev) for programmatic access and integration.
notes.saved-searches: Can save search queries for repeated use, particularly useful for research workflows.

notes.connection-features: Limited explicit backlinking capabilities. Connections mainly through shared tags and group membership.
notes.tag-relationships: Related bookmarks discoverable through shared tags and similar content, but no automated relationship detection.
notes.link-visualization: No visual representation of connections between bookmarks or knowledge graph features.
notes.outliner-connections: Outliner feature allows manual creation of hierarchical relationships between bookmarks but no automatic backlinking.
